messages:
alex: Hey @sam @tanvi — quick ping for reviews on PR #4128: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4128

This toggles the private deploy flow + KMS wiring. Need runtime + security sign-off for next-week canary. CI is green locally but E2E is flaky in CI.

Summary:
- adds kms_key param to bootstrap
- updates deployer to mount KMS creds
- fallback to customer-managed HSM when present

maria: adding runtime + security reviewers. @rachel FYI

sam: Can you summarize runtime impact? Any kernel/quant changes? Is this compatible with 2.1 runtime image?

tanvi: Also pinging runtime infra—we need an explicit rollout plan. If this touches KV cache keys we must be careful.

alex: No kernel/quant changes. Mostly wiring + new config entries. Files changed: infra/deploy/kms.yml, runtime/launcher/entrypoint.py (arg parsing), runtime/launcher/tests/test_kms_args.py (WIP)

Code snippet to run the new unit locally:
```
PYTHONPATH=./runtime pytest runtime/launcher/tests/test_kms_args.py -q
```

sam: ok that helps. Please add a unit asserting existing cache key format isn't changed (cache key includes model_id+version+prefix). Also include a migration note.

alex: will add cache-key unit and migration blurb in PR description. pushing update in a bit.

rachel: Security questions:
- What IAM scope does the KMS role need?
- Are we writing any plaintext secrets to logs during bootstrap?

alex: KMS role is limited to kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt on the specific key arn. We only fetch wrapped key material; nothing is logged plaintext. Audit entries go to the central audit pipeline (audit-topic in prod). I'll add a check in e2e to assert no plaintext in logs.

rachel: please add the e2e assert and a short threat-model note in the PR. After that I can approve.

ci-bot: CI / e2e (linux) — failed — test-deploy-timeout (flaky)

alex: I saw the failure, rerunning CI and pushing a small timeout bump for the test: commit 7f9a2b3

ci-bot: CI / e2e (linux) — rerun — now green

maria: pinging @tanvi for runtime approval once tests pass

tanvi: skimmed diffs — small nit on arg parsing (use argparse default namespace) but not blocking. Requesting that unit for cache key is present — once that's in I can approve.

alex: cache-key unit added in 9c8d5a1, addressed arg nit.

tanvi: Approved :white_check_mark: — thanks

rachel: LGTM :lock: — added short threat-model paragraph and e2e assert.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: 2025-03-22T03:00:00Z (canary-72h window)

alex: Thanks all. Merging after final CI.

ci-bot: All checks passed — merging permitted

alex: Merged and tagged release v0.9.1 — thanks everyone! :tada:
